attributes.name: Sign of the Rider
attributes.powers:
Discard this card to add 1 die to any check. Once during this check, if you would discard a weapon for its power, you may recharge it instead. 

Discard this card to explore your location. Once during this exploration, if you would discard a weapon for its power, you may recharge it instead.

When you play this card, you may reveal another blessing that has the Sign trait to treat this card as if it has that card's powers.
